title: AdFection：数字广告投放零点击间谍软件，2.17亿次响应被污染
summary: Citizen Lab 联合 The Guardian 披露：一家以色列公司通过数字广告竞价系统，向目标用户设备静默投递"零点击"间谍软件，无需用户任何交互即可完成安装。
summary_en: Citizen Lab and The Guardian exposed an Israeli firm's advertising technology infrastructure being abused to silently deliver "zero-click" spyware to targeted individuals through digital ad bidding systems—no user interaction required. The campaign, dubbed AdFection, leverages the normal ad delivery process to weaponize browser and device exploitation, affecting an estimated 217 million ad responses. The Guardian reported the findings on October 15, 2026, with the story reaching 281 points on Hacker News.
body:
Citizen Lab 联合 The Guardian 披露：一家以色列公司通过数字广告竞价系统，向目标用户设备静默投递"零点击"间谍软件，无需用户任何交互即可完成安装。
